map.展馆安全疏散/消防/承重评估工具。按 6 项检查清单评估疏散通道、消防设施与结构: Exhibition hall safety evacuation/fire/load assessment tool. Evaluates evacuation routes, fire equipment, and structural load safety against a six-item checklist, then outputs risk items and remediation suggestions to protect visitors.
map.本页按 6 项清单初筛：出口通行时间 = 人数 ÷（出口总净宽×55 人/(mi: This page performs a six-item preliminary screen: exit flow time = people ÷ (total clear exit width×55 persons/(min·m)), in minutes, excluding alarm response, travel distance and crowd stagnation. Reference width is 0.6 m per 100 people, distance threshold 40 m, density 0.5 persons/m², load 4 kN/m². These thresholds are page examples, not code values; results list items to verify and never declare safety compliance.

The page shows “No page checklist item triggered”, never “safe/compliant”; formal review must be done by fire/structural professionals under local codes.
map.仅按 人数 ÷（出口总净宽×55 人/(min·m)）估算出口通行时间，单位是分: Only exit flow time is estimated as people ÷ (total clear exit width×55 persons/(min·m)), in minutes, with no ×60 conversion. It excludes alarm response, travel distance, stairs, crowd stagnation and disability assistance, and is not a basis for evacuation design or acceptance.
